note: Gosper County has county zoning (joint planning commission, effective 1991, joint zoning with Elwood Village and Johnson Lake), but no public queryable zoning district service was found. The county's parcel/GIS viewer is a Schneider Beacon app (schneidergis.co / beacon.schneidercorp.com) that is Cloudflare-blocked and offers no ArcGIS REST endpoint; the county website returns a rate-limit block; ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Gosper zoning returned nothing; the only zoning attribute data found is a paid commercial parcel shapefile (dynamospatial.com). No city zoning layer was found for Elwood or Smithfield.
